properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 14 at 4:15PM MDT until August 14 at 4:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 415 PM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 5
miles southeast of Deer Trail to 8 miles south of Agate, or along a
line from 26 miles northwest of Limon to 16 miles west of Limon,
moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Agate and Cedar Point.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 14 at 4:11PM MDT until August 14 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 411 PM MDT, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms producing
flash flooding and a car stranded in water 1 mile west of Byers.
Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall
amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash
flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches, roads,
and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Byers and Strasburg.

This includes Interstate 70 between mile markers 307 and 319.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Mule Creek, Muddy Creek, Little Comanche Creek, Comanche Creek,
Rattlesnake Creek, Bijou Creek, Sherman Ranch Slough, Little
Antelope Creek, Wolf Creek, East Bijou Creek, Antelope Creek and
West Bijou Creek.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 4:07PM MDT until August 14 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Adams County in northeastern Colorado...
North Central Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
Central Denver County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 407 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This may cause urban
and small stream flooding. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain has
fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Northeastern Denver, northwestern Aurora, southern Thornton,
Commerce City, Northglenn, Federal Heights, western Denver
International Airport and Henderson.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 14 at 4:04PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:

Higbee, or 20 miles south of North La Junta, moving north at 5 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Higbee.
